why.1: Krishna stands on the shore and does not jump into the Yamuna. No birds are falling, and the hand and object look odd.
why.2: Empty river with tiny standing figures. No clear cows or ग्वाल-बाल lying unconscious.
why.3: Shows a peacock-swan hybrid bird in the water. No Krishna or kadamba jump, and no Kaliya.
why.4: Kaliya is drawn as a feathered peacock-like creature, not a multi-hooded serpent. It is not coiling around Krishna, so the scene doesn't match the line.
why.5: Krishna stands on a feathered peacock tail instead of Kaliya's hoods. There are no serpent hoods, so it doesn't match the narration.
why.6: Krishna kneels with folded hands and a peacock tail behind him. There are no nagpatnis and no Kaliya, so the narration isn't shown.
why.7: A giant peacock-necked creature stands beside a boy. It is not a clear serpent, and the scene doesn't match the narration.
why.C: Large peacock wings grow from Krishna's back, merging bird and person. A small bird flies above.
